limitations.summary: No CVE, advisory, or vulnerability database is consulted.
npm / package.json ecosystems are out of scope for this milestone. No framework or DependencyRole classification is inferred.
Business impact remains unknown without explicit enterprise context for dependency assessment.
Declared vs latest version comparison is not performed.
No package-registry or internet calls are made. Version freshness and remote metadata are not assessed.
Dependency Intelligence does not reparse Maven, Gradle, or Python manifests. Rules consume Dependency Evidence only.
License compliance analysis is not performed.
Inventory and hygiene cover declared-manifest facts only. Transitive dependencies are not resolved. Build tools are not executed. Gradle support is static-parse only.
